listNote: The official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned; no online trophies. Names, descriptions and grades follow the official PSN list [10] as mirrored by Exophase [2] and PSNProfiles [3], which agree on every entry.
auditNote: Every guide below is written for this atlas in our own words. A bracketed number after a step is the source that step rests on; the numbered source list sits in the right rail and in the Sources tab.
disagreementNote: SOURCES DISAGREE on meditations: the trophy guides count 18 meditations across 10 spots [1][8], while the 100% completion checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 [5][7]. Both numbers are shown wherever meditations appear; the trophy itself tracks 18.

stages.title: Story — Chapters 1 to 5
stages.note: Play the campaign in order, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and never skip the Chapter 1 balcony meditation [1].

stages.title: Side stories — Strangers of Leonida
stages.note: Finish every named character's final mission and the eight stranger strands as they open [1][4].

stages.title: Activities — ranges, races & challenges
stages.note: Shooting range golds, drone races, 20 race wins, 250 stunts and 50 challenges, spread across the map [1][6].

stages.title: Collectibles & money
stages.note: Card sets, WAiNK spots, vehicle discovery, garages and the two big money totals [3][8].

stages.title: Robberies & open-world moments
stages.note: Vaults, trucks, gang operations and the one-off hidden moments, all doable in free roam after the story [4][9].

stages.title: 100% checklist & platinum
stages.note: Close out the completion checklist, then the gold and the platinum pop on their own [1][5].

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is a receipt, not a task: it lands the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned [2][10]. Plan around the long gold, A Long Road, and treat everything else as stages of one run — the launch roadmap rates the full set 4/10 and roughly 200 hours in a single playthrough, with no online or difficulty trophies in the way [1].
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one pops automatically on the last of them [2].
Follow the six roadmap stages in order so nothing is left stranded at the end [1].
Expect A Long Road (100% completion) to be the final trophy for most players [1][5].

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story beat that awards itself: finish the mission named Gone Fishing and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen [2][10]. It cannot be skipped over, because the campaign is linear, so the only advice is to play on and let it land [1].
steps: Play the campaign until the mission Gone Fishing begins [2].
Finish the mission; the trophy pops as it completes [10].

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 mission and the chapter trophy follows [2]. Before you close the chapter out, clear the one fragile item in it: the balcony meditation at Jason's house tied to Positive Mental Attitude, which disappears when Chapter 1 ends [1][8]. Keep a manual save from the chapter start as insurance, since the game offers no mission replay [1].
steps: Make a manual save at the very start of Chapter 1 [1].
Do the Jason's house balcony meditation with Lucia before the chapter ends [1][8].
Complete the remaining Chapter 1 missions to pop the trophy [2].

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 completion trophy, asterisks and all, exactly as PSN publishes the name [2][10]. Chapter 2 is also where both protagonists become playable, which is what unlocks the two-character meditation counting used later [1]. Finish the chapter's missions in order and it pops [2].
steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 2 [1].
Play through every Chapter 2 mission; both characters unlock along the way [1].
The trophy pops when the chapter closes [2].

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3's completion trophy [2]. Nothing in the chapter is missable for trophy purposes, so the efficient play is to keep moving, scan new vehicles with WAiNK as they appear, and bank progress toward the collectible counters while the story drives you around the map [8].
steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 3 [1].
Complete the chapter's missions in order [2].
WAiNK-scan unfamiliar vehicles between missions to feed the 100-location counter [8].

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 completion trophy [2][10]. By this point most side strands and activities are open, so finish the chapter first, then sweep side content before the finale — the roadmap keeps all clean-up after the story, when the whole map is available [1].
steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 4 [1].
Complete the chapter's missions; the trophy pops at chapter end [2].

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of only two golds, awarded for finishing the campaign's final mission [2][3]. It is story-locked rather than skill-locked: reach the end of Chapter 5 and complete the finale, and the gold is yours [1]. Keep that chapter-start save habit to the very end [1].
steps: Play through Chapter 5 to the final mission [2].
Complete the final mission; the gold pops at its end [3].
Stay in free roam afterwards — all clean-up content remains available [1].

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run and the trophy is awarded automatically [2]. It sits on the campaign's critical path, so no detour, choice or medal is involved [1][10].
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story [2].
Complete it; the trophy pops with the mission [10].

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story set-piece The Cartel Heist [2]. As a scripted campaign heist it cannot be missed or failed permanently — retry the mission until it clears and the trophy follows [1].
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the campaign [2].
Finish the heist mission; the trophy pops on completion [10].

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play during the campaign [2]. Like the other named-mission trophies it is awarded on completion with no extra condition attached [3][10].
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play [2].
Complete it to earn the trophy [3].

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners [2]. A straight campaign completion award — play the story and it arrives in sequence [1].
steps: Reach the mission Headliners in the story [2].
Finish the mission; the trophy pops [10].

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, the campaign mission set around the airport authority [2]. Completion is the only condition; the airport area it introduces matters again later for Catch Me If You Can [9].
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the campaign [2].
Complete the mission; the trophy pops [10].

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in the campaign [2]. Another automatic story award with no side condition [3].
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory [2].
Finish the mission to earn the trophy [3].

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold and the longest haul: fill the in-game 100% checklist, which PSN tracks as a 0–100 counter [3]. The checklist is more forgiving than it looks — launch guides report thresholds rather than totals in several categories, such as 15 of 18 meditations and a subset of card sets [5][7]. Work the checklist screen category by category and let this atlas's counters mirror it [5].
steps: Open the Progress menu and work the 100% checklist one category at a time [5].
Note the challenge quota inside it: the roadmap's 100% step works to 70 of 80 challenges, not all 80 [1].
Use the thresholds: where the checklist asks for part of a set (for example 15 of 18 meditations), stop there and move on [5][7].
Finish the story, side strands, activities and collectible quotas the checklist names [1].
The gold pops when the checklist reaches 100% [3].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 100 %. The tracker chip counts 0 / 100 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts; PSN counts every one toward the silver [3]. Stunt opportunities are scattered across Leonida's ramps, roofs and causeways, so the sane method is steady accumulation: take stunt jumps whenever a drive passes one instead of grinding them all at the end [1][6]. Failed attempts cost nothing but time [6].
steps: Turn on stunt and collectible notifications in settings so nearby stunts surface [8].
Complete stunts opportunistically on every long drive; the counter is tracked by PSN at 250 [3].
Sweep the remaining stunt spots in free roam once the map is fully open [1].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 250 stunts. The tracker chip counts 0 / 250 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once — PSN tracks the set at 9 types [3]. Nothing needs to be won or mastered; a single attempt at each distinct activity icon on the map is enough, which makes this a natural by-product of exploring [6][9].
steps: Open the map legend and list the distinct activity types [9].
Attempt each type once; one try per type is all the description asks [2].
Check the counter (9 types) in the Progress menu before hunting the last one [3].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 9 activity types. The tracker chip counts 0 / 9 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges, the count PSN tracks [3]. Learn each range's target pattern at bronze pace first, then chase gold once the rhythm is familiar; accuracy streaks matter more than raw speed in the launch guides' accounts [4][6]. This is the activities stage's main skill check [1].
steps: Unlock the shooting ranges and run each challenge once to learn its pattern [6].
Replay challenges until every one shows a gold medal — 42 in total [3].
Prioritise accuracy streaks over speed when a gold score stays out of reach [4].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 42 range challenges. The tracker chip counts 0 / 42 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location; PSN tracks 14 locations [3]. A win at a location is permanent, so clear them one by one and re-fly only the losses — drone handling improves fast with repetition, and each course is short [6][9].
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race start on the map; there are 14 locations [3].
Race until you win at that location, then move to the next [6].
Revisit only locations without a recorded win until the counter fills [9].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 14 locations. The tracker chip counts 0 / 14 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeat wins on the same event do not advance the counter [3]. Bring a suitably fast vehicle for each class, learn the first two corners of a new course on a throwaway run, then race it properly [4][6].
steps: Enter races across different events; the counter needs 20 distinct wins [3].
Match your vehicle to each race class before starting [6].
Track distinct wins in the Progress menu so no event is farmed twice by mistake [4].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 20 race wins. The tracker chip counts 0 / 20 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in his fishing challenge [2]. Fishing is a side activity that opens through the character strands; once Cal offers the challenge, keep casting until your catch beats his — the contest can be retried if he wins a round [4][9].
steps: Progress the side content until Cal's fishing challenge is offered [9].
Enter the challenge and land a better catch than Cal's [2].
Retry the challenge if Cal wins; attempts are repeatable [4].

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to credits [2]. Any cabinet counts, so pick the shortest game on offer and play it through rather than sampling several [6][9].
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in the open world [9].
Play one game through to completion [2].
The trophy pops when the game ends [6].

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand by completing his final mission [2]. Side strands unlock in sequence, so work each of Andy's markers as they appear; the trophy only cares about the last one [4]. Nothing in the strand is missable — markers wait for you [1].
steps: Start Andy's strand when his first marker appears [4].
Complete each of his missions in order [2].
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy [3].

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission to close his strand [2]. As with the other named side strands, the missions arrive in a fixed order and the trophy waits at the end of the chain [4].
steps: Pick up Kenton's strand when it opens [4].
Work through his missions in sequence [2].
Complete the final mission for the trophy [3].

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at his final mission [2]. Keep his markers in your rotation between story chapters so the strand never lags behind the campaign [1][4].
steps: Start Billy's missions when his marker appears [4].
Complete the strand in order [2].
Finish the final mission to earn the trophy [3].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: A silver for breadth: complete eight full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida; PSN counts the strands [3]. The named strands in this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are the backbone — finish those, then round out the total with whichever stranger strands you meet while exploring [1][4].
steps: Complete the five named character strands tracked elsewhere in this list [2].
Take stranger markers as they appear across the state; each finished strand adds one [3].
Stop at eight completed strands; the silver pops on the eighth [3].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 8 strands. The tracker chip counts 0 / 8 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Close out Randy's strand with his final mission [2]. Strand missions unlock one after another, so if his marker vanishes, progress the story or his earlier jobs and it returns [4].
steps: Begin Randy's strand when offered [4].
Complete his missions in order [2].
Finish the final mission for the trophy [3].

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission [2]. The last of the five named strands in this list; finishing it also moves Strangers & Freaks most of the way to its eight-strand total [3][4].
steps: Start Tyrone's strand from his first marker [4].
Play the strand through in sequence [2].
Complete the final mission to pop the trophy [3].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one trophy in the game that can be lost. The guides count 18 meditations spread over 10 spots, and meditating at a spot as both Jason and Lucia counts twice toward the 18 [1][8]. The fragile piece is the first one: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says in Jason's kitchen that she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and accept — that meditation is gone for good once Chapter 1 ends, and whether the trophy strictly needs it is still unconfirmed, which is exactly why you do it [1][8]. SOURCES DISAGREE: the trophy route counts all 18 [1], while the 100% checklist is satisfied with 15 of 18 [5][7] — plan for 18 and treat 15 as the checklist's shortcut, not the trophy's. Every later spot stays available in free roam, and progress shows under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations [1].
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from Jason's kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation — before Chapter 1 ends [1][8].
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until that meditation is banked [1].
From Chapter 2 on, both characters are playable, so meditate at each spot as Jason and as Lucia to count +2 per spot [1][8].
Work the spots across Leonida until the counter reaches 18 of 18 [3][8].
If you only need the 100% checklist, it accepts 15 of 18 — but the trophy itself tracks the full 18 [5][7].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 18 meditations. The tracker chip counts 0 / 18 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track and hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after [2]. WATCH: the hunt is a one-off encounter rather than a repeatable activity, so approach it prepared — study the animal, take the right weapon, and save before the final approach so a spooked target is a reload, not a regret [4][9].
steps: Take Bret's hunting request when his strand offers it [9].
Save before closing in on the unique animal [4].
Hunt the animal successfully to earn the trophy [2].

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three full collectible card sets; PSN tracks the sets at 3 [3]. Cards are found one by one across the state, so work set by set instead of grabbing random singles — and note the 100% checklist reportedly accepts a subset of sets, while this silver wants three complete ones [5][7].
steps: Pick one card set and collect every card in it before starting another [5].
Use the Progress menu to see which cards a set still needs [3].
Finish three complete sets for the silver [3].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 3 card sets. The tracker chip counts 0 / 3 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations; PSN counts each new location once [3]. The efficient habit is to WAiNK whenever you arrive somewhere new — a fresh district, business or landmark — rather than touring all 100 at the end [8]. (The 100% route separately talks about scanning 200 vehicles with the same app; that is the checklist's number, not this trophy's [8].)
steps: Open the WAiNK app at every new location you visit [8].
Check the location counter in the Progress menu; it needs 100 distinct locations [3].
Sweep untouched districts in free roam to close the last locations [8].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 100 WAiNK locations. The tracker chip counts 0 / 100 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind; PSN counts them individually [3]. Challenges surface everywhere — driving, combat, exploration — so turn challenge notifications on and bank them as they appear instead of hunting the full 50 late [1][8]. The 100% route leans on challenges too, so this progress is never wasted [1].
steps: Enable challenge and progress notifications in settings [8].
Complete challenges as they trigger during normal play [1].
Top the counter up to 50 with easy repeatable categories in free roam [3].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 50 challenges. The tracker chip counts 0 / 50 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: WATCH: the setup is specific — you need a full 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then a clean escape [2]. Deliberately raise the heat together, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars clear; doing it by accident is possible but planning it is faster [4][9].
steps: Free-roam with your partner present [9].
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars [2].
Break line of sight and hide until the wanted level is fully lost [4].

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: WATCH: a chained feat — rob three shops in a row with your partner while the wanted level never fully drops between them [2]. Pick three shops close together, keep the heat alive as you move between them, and drive decisively; losing the stars resets the chain [4][6].
steps: Scout three shops near each other and bring your partner [6].
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level active as you leave [2].
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back without the wanted level clearing [4].

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles; PSN counts each new model once [3]. Discovery comes from encountering and scanning vehicles as they appear in traffic and parked spots, so variety of district matters more than hours — rich areas, ports and rural roads all stock different pools [8][9].
steps: Scan or enter unfamiliar vehicles whenever a new model appears [8].
Rotate districts — downtown, beach, port and countryside stock different vehicles [9].
Check the discovered counter until it reaches 100 [3].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 100 vehicles. The tracker chip counts 0 / 100 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: WATCH: five takedowns inside one Combat Focus activation is a setup problem, not a reflex test [2]. Wait for a crowded encounter, line your targets up before triggering the ability, and spend the window on the nearest enemies first [4][6].
steps: Find an encounter with at least five enemies grouped together [6].
Position and aim before activating Combat Focus [4].
Take down five enemies before the single activation ends [2].

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: WATCH: an airport stunt — make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport from the story's VCIA Takedown [2]. In plain terms: get airborne from the airport without being a scheduled flight; take a plane from the field and leave the ground [9]. Expect a wanted response, so plan the exit [9].
steps: Head to VCIA in free roam [9].
Take an aircraft from the airport grounds [2].
Get airborne — the unscheduled departure — and clear the area [9].

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: the official description only hints — Rhinos are the game's tanks, and the joke says it gets hot in them [2][10]. Launch coverage has not yet pinned the exact trigger down, so this atlas marks the method unconfirmed rather than inventing one: the working reading is a feat performed in a Rhino tank, and the entry will be updated as guides confirm it [9].
steps: Locate a Rhino tank in free roam [9].
Attempt the feat the description hints at from inside the tank [2].
Treat any exact method as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it [9].

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: WATCH: a clean-hands robbery — empty a jewelry store without ever being detected [2]. Scout the store's sightlines first, move quietly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm; a spotted attempt simply means trying the next store clean [4][6].
steps: Choose a jewelry store and watch its patrol and camera pattern first [6].
Enter quietly and rob it without being seen [2].
Leave undetected; the trophy pops on a clean getaway [4].

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: WATCH: rob five bank vaults and escape each time — a vault only counts when you get away, so the getaway is half the job [2][3]. Prepare a fast vehicle and an escape route before each vault, and space the robberies out so heat management stays simple [4].
steps: Stage a getaway vehicle and route before entering a bank [4].
Rob the vault and escape; PSN counts five escaped vault robberies [3].
Repeat at different banks until the counter reaches 5 [2].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 5 vaults. The tracker chip counts 0 / 5 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop and rob an armored truck, then escape [2]. Block the truck, deal with its guards, take the cash and break line of sight quickly — the escape, not the robbery, is what the description demands [4][9].
steps: Find an armored truck on its route in free roam [9].
Stop it and rob it [2].
Escape the response to complete the trophy [4].

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore the whole state; PSN tracks the exploration counter at 52 [3]. Fog clears as you travel, so this is a coverage exercise: tour each region, island and stretch of highway once, and check the map for the last grey patches near the end [8][9].
steps: Travel every region of Leonida as the story and side content open them [9].
Watch the exploration counter (52) in the Progress menu [3].
Sweep the last unexplored patches in free roam to finish [8].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 52 areas. The tracker chip counts 0 / 52 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation run by each gang; PSN tracks the set at 9 [3]. Variety is the requirement — nine robberies at the same gang's sites will not finish it, so note which gangs you have already hit and travel for the rest [4][9].
steps: Identify an illegal operation and the gang that owns it [9].
Rob it and escape [2].
Repeat until every gang has been robbed once — 9 operations on the counter [3].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 9 operations. The tracker chip counts 0 / 9 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED in its fine detail: the description points at a quiet moment — a cocktail, a view, Ocean Beach [2][10]. Head to Ocean Beach and look for the spot that offers the drink-with-a-view interaction; launch guides had not published the exact trigger when these sources were read, so the location is cited and the precise spot is honestly open [9].
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach [2].
Find the cocktail spot overlooking the water and use it [9].
The trophy pops when the moment completes [10].

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as to which showroom: the description asks for a drive-through exit from a vehicle showroom, through the glass, in a car [2]. Take a vehicle from inside a showroom and drive out through the storefront rather than the door; if one showroom does not trigger it, try the next — the exact site was not pinned in the launch sources read for this atlas [9].
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and get into a car inside [9].
Drive out through the storefront glass [2].
Try another showroom if the first does not pop it — the site is unconfirmed [9].

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED in method: the description names the place — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — and a bowling term, follow-through [2][10]. Visit the alley and bowl; whether it wants a strike, a full game or a specific throw was not settled in the sources read, so start with a complete game and a clean follow-through motion [6][9].
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley [2].
Bowl a full game there [6].
If it does not pop, the precise trigger is still unconfirmed in launch guides [9].

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: the description is a riddle about the partnership — Jason and Lucia together, with mass appeal [2][10]. No launch guide read for this atlas had verified the trigger, so it is flagged unconfirmed instead of guessed at; it sits with the other partner-flavoured feats, and the honest advice is to keep both characters active in free roam and watch for it during partner activities [9].
steps: Treat the trigger as unverified; do not trust any exact method yet [9].
Play partner activities with Jason and Lucia together [2].
Check back against the numbered sources as launch guides confirm it [4].

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED in meaning, clear in scale: PSN tracks a counter of 500 against this trophy [3], and the description ties it to choices made through the game [2]. The working reading is that in-game choices accumulate toward 500 — make them as they come and let the counter build naturally across a full playthrough [3][9].
steps: Note the PSN counter: 500 [3].
Make story and world choices as they arise; do not stall progress hunting them [9].
If the counter lags late, the exact definition is still unconfirmed in launch sources [9].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 500 choices. The tracker chip counts 0 / 500 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: 'second time's the charm' implies failing or missing something once and succeeding on the retry [2]. No source read for this atlas had isolated which activity it belongs to, so it is listed unconfirmed; many players will likely earn it by accident while retrying activities for other trophies [9].
steps: Treat the trigger as unverified for now [9].
Retry failed activities rather than reloading instantly — a second attempt is the theme [2].
Expect it during normal clean-up play [9].

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: a hidden oddity trophy — the description reacts to something strange rather than naming it [2][10]. Leonida hides weird encounters off the beaten path; explore remote spots at odd hours and investigate anything out of place [9]. The exact encounter was not confirmed in the launch sources, and this entry says so rather than inventing a location [9].
steps: Explore remote corners of Leonida between other objectives [9].
Investigate strange encounters when they appear [2].
The trigger event is unconfirmed in launch guides — report what your game shows [9].

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: WATCH: knock pedestrians down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by, bowled over like pins [2]. Line up a group on a pavement edge, drive past at moderate speed and swing as you pass; too fast flattens the attempt, too slow lands nothing [6][9].
steps: Find a group of pedestrians along a street edge [9].
Drive past at moderate speed and melee as you pass them [2].
Repeat until the group goes down in one pass [6].

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills through your contacts until the total reaches $250,000; PSN tracks the dollars [3]. Marked bills come from robberies, so this pairs naturally with the stage 5 robbery trophies — bank the bills after every job instead of spending them, and the total climbs on its own [4][8].
steps: Collect marked bills from robberies and jobs [4].
Launder them through your contacts rather than spending them raw [2].
Watch the laundered total climb to $250,000 [3].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 250000 dollars laundered. The tracker chip counts 0 / 250000 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops; PSN tracks the spend [3]. Spread purchases across shops as the description says — vehicles, clothes, weapons and services all count toward the same running total in the launch accounts [6][9]. Buy what your run needs anyway and top up near the end [6].
steps: Buy gear, vehicles and services as you play; spending accumulates [6].
Check the spend counter (target $100,000) in the Progress menu [3].
Make any shortfall up with late-game purchases [9].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 100000 dollars spent. The tracker chip counts 0 / 100000 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market; PSN tracks the set at 8 [3]. Garages unlock for purchase as funds and story progress allow, so keep cash aside from the robbery stage and buy each one as it appears rather than saving for a single sweep [4][8].
steps: Watch the property market as garages become available [8].
Buy each garage when it appears; there are 8 in total [3].
The trophy pops on the final purchase [2].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 8 garages. The tracker chip counts 0 / 8 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app; PSN counts the registrations [3]. Register vehicles you actually keep — favourites from each class — instead of the first ten wrecks you find, so the garage stays useful for races and getaways [6][9].
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app when you acquire a vehicle worth keeping [9].
Register it; each registration adds one to the counter [3].
Reach 10 registered vehicles for the trophy [2].
trophies.targetNote: PSN progress target: 10 vehicles registered. The tracker chip counts 0 / 10 until you log progress; reaching the target marks the trophy earned.
